discrepancies.explanation: The translation completely omits the word 'sexily' (செக்ஸியா) when describing how they can talk.

policy_moments.reference_text: அப்புறமா வீடியோ காட்டுறேன் வாட்ஸ்அப் கால் பண்றீங்களா அப்படின்னு கேப்பாங்க
policy_moments.translation_text: Then they will ask, 'I'll show you a video, will you call me on WhatsApp?'
They will say they will show you their body

summary: The translation is mostly accurate but omits the explicit mention of talking 'sexily', though it preserves the warnings about scammers asking to move to WhatsApp, showing their body, and stealing money.
